subject: Vendr onboarding: SIG evidence split & ownership cadence
messages:
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@brightleaf.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-team@brightleaf.com
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr onboarding: SIG + SOC2 evidence — ownership question

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting the Vendr portal upload for Brightleaf's SIG intake and have a few questions before we proceed:

1) Ownership split — Brightleaf typically hosts our infrastructure evidence (network diagrams, VPC configs, syslog extracts). We need Redwood to provide app-level artifacts (auth flows, RBAC screenshots, change management docs) and a signed SOC2 report. Can you confirm which artifacts Redwood will upload versus which we'll host?

2) Rotation cadence — for items that change (presigned URLs, temp credentials, service account manifests), we prefer a quarterly rotation. Is that compatible with Redwood's evidence cadence?

3) Portal invites — please add security@brightleaf.com as an owner on Vendr so they can pull artifacts if needed. We'll also need a single point of contact for CAIQ mapping questions.

Attached is a starting CAIQ field map for reference (CAIQ-field-map.xlsx).

Let me know if you want to set a 30-minute kickoff to triage ownership and upload windows.

Thanks,
Tom Harris\Head of Security Operations
Brightleaf

---
Attachment: CAIQ-field-map.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 58 KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@brightleaf.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: SIG + SOC2 evidence — ownership question

Thanks Tom — looping in Karthik and Ben to coordinate. Quick notes from my side:

- Confirmed split proposal (high-level):
  * Brightleaf: network diagrams, cloud provider attestations, syslog samples, KMS configuration screenshots
  * Redwood: application architecture diagram, RBAC screenshots, change control runbook excerpt, SOC2 report (scoped)

- Rotation cadence: quarterly rotation sounds fine for temp creds/presigned uploads. For SOC2 and formal attestations we will follow our annual cadence (we can surface interim evidence if requested).

Action items I propose:
  1) Karthik: accept Vendr owner invite and validate Brightleaf can pull the app-level artifacts (confirm permissions).
  2) Ben: prepare a trimmed SOC2 extract (redacted client list) and the RBAC screenshots; place on our S3 evidence bucket and mark uploads for Vendr.
  3) I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff with Tom to walk the ownership grid and confirm the HubSpot deal owner.

I'll attach the Vendr invite screenshot (vendr-invite.png) for tracking and start a shared checklist in Drive after the call.

Best,
Irene Choi\Security & Compliance Program Manager\Redwood Inference\n---
Attachment: vendr-invite.png (image stub)

Sounds good. I accepted the Vendr invite and confirmed our role is "Contributor" with upload rights to the Brightleaf profile. A couple quick notes:

- I tested a small object upload to the vendr-presign bucket and the link resolves for external viewers when set to the "Brightleaf" profile.
- I'll take the CAIQ mapping for sections A (Access Control) and F (Change Management). Ben, can you take Section C (Infrastructure) screenshots and the SOC2 extract?

Proposed kickoff: 2028-06-22T10:00:00-07:00 (30m). Sent a calendar request: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=brightleaf-vendr-kickoff

Karthik

Tom / Brightleaf security —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Short update after internal prep and the presign test:

- Ownership grid (finalized):
  * Brightleaf: network topology export, cloud provider CAIQ claims, syslog sample (redacted), KMS policy screenshots
  * Redwood: application auth flow doc (attached), RBAC screenshots (in progress), trimmed SOC2 extract (see attachment).

- Rotation & retention: quarterly temp-credential rotation accepted. We'll add a metadata tag in Vendr to indicate the next rotation window; Karthik will own the tag update.

- Kickoff scheduled: 2028-06-22T10:00 PT (calendar link above). Agenda: ownership matrix, upload windows, CAIQ field mapping questions.

Next steps for Brightleaf: please add security@brightleaf.com as a Portal Owner in Vendr (Tom indicated they will). For Redwood: Ben will upload the SOC2 extract (SOC2-report-2027.pdf) and an evidence checklist (evidence-checklist.pdf) to the vendr-presign bucket by end of day tomorrow.
